title: Rapid Prototyping for Community Garden Management
business: Local neighborhood associations managing shared garden plots and volunteer schedules.
problem: Manual tracking of plot assignments and volunteer hours via spreadsheets leads to scheduling conflicts and data fragmentation.
solution: Using Lovable to generate a full-stack web application that integrates a PostgreSQL database for real-time tracking of plot status and volunteer shifts.
steps: Describe the garden management requirements to Lovable to generate the initial TypeScript and shadcn/ui interface.
Refine the UI through follow-up natural language prompts to add specific filtering for plot availability.
Connect a PostgreSQL database to persist user data and volunteer shift logs.
Review the generated code and diffs to ensure data validation logic matches neighborhood rules.
Publish the finished application to a public URL for immediate community access.
outcome: A centralized, accessible platform that reduces administrative overhead and improves volunteer coordination through automated status tracking.
limitation: The generated code may require manual auditing for complex business logic, which can be checked by inspecting the diffs provided during the refinement process.
